heroHeadline: Spain's CNI Intelligence Agency Had Warned of Imminent Mass Crossings Into Ceuta Before Crisis
heroSubtitle: Spain's intelligence agency CNI had warned of imminent mass crossings into Ceuta before the border crisis erupted, raising questions about whether Spanish authorities acted on the intelligence in time. This follows EU approval of €115 million in emergency aid for Spain and Brussels dispatching a technical mission to Ceuta.
